text:
kiran: kicking off a small staged rollout plan for model 'rwd-encoder-v3-nf4' to a 2% pilot segment. quick summary: NF4 quant gives ~2.3x token cost win but shadow shows a +0.62% absolute increase in safety rejections on the pilot slice. want to lock rollout gates before we flip any traffic.

maria: can you paste the A/B numbers and latency deltas? what exact signal would force an auto-revert?

samir: a quick dump from the last 24h shadow vs control:
- requests: ~12k per arm
- safety_reject_rate: control 1.12% -> pilot 1.74% (+0.62% abs)
- semantic_accept_rate: 99.12% -> 98.70% (-0.42% abs)
- p95 latency: 270ms -> 298ms (+28ms)
- tokens/sec: +2.0x throughput on batch workloads
stats: reject delta p<0.01, semantic accept p~0.02. sample-sliced by product.

ops-bot: smoke checks passed on gpu-pool-5, kv-cache hit steady, no OOMs. model artifacts present: rwd-encoder-v3-nf4:sha256:abc123.

anya: suggestion: make rollback rules conservative but actionable. propose auto-fallback if ANY of: safety_reject_delta > 0.5% OR semantic_accept_drop > 0.3% OR p95_latency_inc > 40ms. also require a quiet-burn of 30m at each ramp step before increasing to the next tier.

samir: +1 to those thresholds. also add requirement for 3 consecutive watch windows with no regression and at least one human-eval spot check pass on sampled failures.

kiran: proposed rollout config (YAML-ish for clarity):
```
rollout:
  pilot: 2%
  ramp: [2, 5, 20]
  watch_windows: [30m, 1h, 2h]
  rollback_if:
    - metric: safety_reject_delta
      threshold: 0.005
      comparator: '>'
    - metric: semantic_accept_delta
      threshold: -0.003
      comparator: '<'
    - metric: p95_latency_delta_ms
      threshold: 40
      comparator: '>'
  autofallback: true
  quiet_burn: 30m
```
any objections?

maria: :thumbsup: one extra ask — enforce per-customer exposure caps. i.e. per-customer max 1% traffic until global reaches 20%, and require opt-in for heavy enterprise tenants.

deploy-bot: scheduled window set for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. pre-rollout tasks: shadow-compare on critical slices, smoke run, delta-eval. will auto-revert when any rollback rule trips.

kiran: i'll run a targeted shadow compare for finance/auth flows before the pilot. cc @anya for audit checks.

anya: i'll run slice audits and post a short report here. adding an "introspect" check to capture hallucination-token spikes (>0.1% of tokens flagged) during quiet-burn.

samir: if safety regressions persist post-quiet-burn, immediate revert to v3-float + ablative pull-apart analysis to find offending ops.

maria: thanks — if the shadow compare is clean and ops smoke passes, proceed with pilot. keep this thread updated with the short audit report and the rolling metrics. :eyes:
